future_canary.behavior: Clone supplied pinned scale config into fresh random namespace, admit/prepare 257-row raw canary, admit/publish/verify schedule/measure/reduce, then single ownership-checked cleanup even on error. Preserves original full config and state. Two canary queries are synthetic validation, not quality/performance evidence.
future_canary.limit: The fixed 257-row real canary cannot qualify full PUT throughput or eight PUTs; native loopback 4501-row fixture covers concurrency. A future paid full run remains root-owned.
future_canary.cleanup_barrier: All durable reservations must be observed before trap may dispatch cleanup; unknown calls preserve receipts for operator reconciliation.
future_canary.prerequisites: Separate root authorization, valid causality profile in retained root, clear current experiment/resource lane, approved service/cost envelope; command is supplied but was not executed.
